title: FEATURE — fal.ai persisted circuit breaker to skip 5-min timeout waste across pipeline runs
rationale: fal-video-client.ts has an in-memory circuit breaker (FAL_CIRCUIT_THRESHOLD=2) that resets on process restart. When fal.ai is down, each new pipeline run wastes 2x150s=5min waiting before tripping. Fix: write data/fal-circuit.json when circuit trips; check it on startup; auto-clear after 10min TTL. Gradient fallback (Sprint 1339) already handles production correctly — this only saves 5min/run during outages.

tasks.description: In scripts/scs001/fal-video-client.ts: on circuit trip, write data/fal-circuit.json {tripped_at, ttl_ms:600000}. On module load, check if file exists and is within TTL; if so, set falConsecutiveTimeouts=FAL_CIRCUIT_THRESHOLD immediately. Clear file when circuit resets (successful call).
